name: dsh-gittree
description: History (package and row `dsh-gittree`, kind/address `gittree` / `sidebar://gittree`): a READ-ONLY git history tab type for the vn-harness right bar (dsh-rightbar). Lists the session workspace's commits (short id, subject, author, date) in the bar's own dress, with the branch and the current commit kept in the file bar above it; picking a commit shows its message and the files it touched, and any of those files opens through the ordinary file address (so the editor or a shipped preview claims it). A page type like the editor: one guide entry on the tab strip's + / Start page, no core patches, nothing forked, and no git command that can write. Alpha.
